declarations.title: Selected Lambda literal environment variables have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected Lambda environment and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Prefer scoped runtime identity or secret references.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in selected Lambda environment variables.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

fixture.origin: Independent native botocore Stubber GetCallerIdentity and exact GetFunctionConfiguration through AWS collector and engine; actual pinned Kingfisher1.4.0/TruffleHog3.92.5 PASS/FAIL, native AccessDenied UNKNOWN. No live cloud/auth/credential validation.
